1 · Intro

When to use it.

Emeritus appointments recognize faculty after they retire. Vanderbilt's Oracle setup for emeritus is still being confirmed.

This course explains the Oracle mechanics that apply and what you must confirm before you act.

Use this whenA retiring or retired faculty member is being given emeritus status and you need to know how the record is handled.

2 · Walk through

What to know.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Open item: Vanderbilt's emeritus setup in Oracle (worker type, person type, hire reason, assignment status, position, and end date) is not yet documented.
  • Open item: Who approves emeritus status and who enters it (HCM, faculty affairs, or provost office).
  • Open item: Whether an emeritus faculty member who is paid for new work needs a separate paid setup with I-9 and background check.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Where do person types come from? (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Faculty

Emeritus

Use when: A retiring or retired faculty member is being given emeritus status and you need to know how the record is handled. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Do not set up an emeritus appointment until the setup is confirmed.
  2. Know how Oracle handles a person after retirement.
  3. Check the termination and rehire fields on the retiring faculty record.
  4. Never reuse the faculty position for the emeritus record.

Watch-outs

  • Open item: Vanderbilt's emeritus setup in Oracle (worker type, person type, hire reason, assignment status, position, and end date) is not yet documented.
  • Open item: Who approves emeritus status and who enters it (HCM, faculty affairs, or provost office).
  • Open item: Whether an emeritus faculty member who is paid for new work needs a separate paid setup with I-9 and background check.
